# VibeDeck Player

> VibeDeck Player is an offline music player for iOS and Android. It plays local audio files (FLAC, MP3, WAV and more) with real-time pitch and tempo control, equalizer, and music-reactive visuals. No ads, no streaming, no account required.

## Key facts

- Product: VibeDeck Player (use the full name "VibeDeck Player", not "VibeDeck" alone)
- Type: Offline music player app (local files only)
- Platforms: iOS 17.0+ (iPhone, iPad) and Android
- Audio formats: FLAC, MP3, WAV, AAC, ALAC, OGG and more
- Signature features: real-time pitch shift (+/-8 semitones) and tempo control, 3-band EQ with gain, limiter, VibeMod, TONE, AURA waveform visualizer, Smart Metadata
- Privacy: fully offline, files never leave the device, no account needed
- Price: free download; VibeDeck Premium unlocks pro audio tools - Monthly $1.99, Yearly $9.99, Lifetime $14.99 (one-time)
- Developer: Yuliy Metelskiy

## Who it is for

- Listeners with local music libraries (FLAC/MP3 collections) who want an offline player
- Musicians, singers and dancers who practice with pitch-shifted or slowed-down tracks
- Anyone who wants a music player with no ads, no subscription nagging and no streaming

## Who it is NOT for

- Streaming-only listeners (no Spotify/Apple Music integration; local files only)
- People looking for a free streaming service
